question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**limited**" means restricted in size, amount, or extent; few, small, or confined. (सीमित)
 
• In the context of the passage, describing the interpretation of literacy as **"limited" **highlights that viewing literacy merely as the ability to sign one's name is a narrow and incomplete perspective.
 
• The other options: "**daunted**," "**small**," and "**wide**" do not fit well in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Isn’t that a very limited__, simplistic interpretation of the word?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Daunted (घबराया हुआ)**: means feeling intimidated or apprehensive. It does not fit the context of describing an interpretation.
 
• **Small (छोटा)**: although related to size, it does not convey the same nuance of restriction or narrowness as "limited."
 
• **Wide (चौड़ा)**: means extensive or broad. This is the opposite of what is intended in the context.
